reviews.title: Rarely works, limited use even if you pay
reviews.text:
When I first downloaded this app about 10 years ago it was great.  Free to use (with ads) no limits on texting and it was reliable.  Now I pay $4 a month and only get notified I have a text message about half the time. I primarily use it to link to a telegram account now so it’s worth the $4, but might I add telegram is free and I never miss a text message or hit any usage limits, whereas if I text someone on this app I eventually get into usage limits.

Pretty lame. Would be one star if I wasn’t able to use it for that.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: I had Talkatone for a couple years now. I know apps can have bugs and need a tweak every once in a while, but I haven’t been able to use my Talkatone for a week now. I have reached out to customer support three times. I get the auto messages but nothing is ever done to help me fix my issue. I have deleted and reinstalled the app multiple times. I pay for a permanent number. I even gave it some time thinking it’s a system glitch , it will clear up in a few hours. Nothing… nothing….and not even a call to help me… I’m truely disappointed. This app helped me so much when I was in the hospital with no cellphone service but only wifi… I could always call my elderly mom ( who has the app) and we could keep contact during the hospital stay. Especially useful during the pandemic as you can’t go in with your loved one. This is why I am so upset ! How can the app not work all of a sudden?? I can’t place calls or get them either. When people call I just get a notice of a missed call ! Or a message! I can’t text out anymore, can’t send a pic. Nothing!! I’m so upset! I want to be refunded for the charges to maintain a non working number!! What’s the point of keeping it if I can get my calls right??

reviews.title: DO NOT USE FOR IMPORTANT CALLS
reviews.text:
I cannot recommend Talkatone based on my experience.

The service stopped working while I still had an active paid subscription. My Talkatone phone number had been listed on months of job applications and resumes, so when the service failed, I lost access to the number prospective employers had for me. I also received at least one call that I could not access, along with my voicemail.

I contacted Talkatone support, but I never received a response or a resolution. Instead, the subscription renewed the very next day, and I was charged again for a service that was already unusable.

I then had to spend additional time pursuing a refund through Apple because Talkatone never addressed the underlying problem.

This wasn’t just an inconvenience. It potentially affected my job search.

If you are considering using Talkatone as your primary phone number for anything important—especially employment, medical appointments, or other time-sensitive communications—understand that if something goes wrong, you may find yourself without a working phone number and without timely support.

For me, the service failed when I needed it most, and the lack of customer support was just as disappointing as the outage itself.

I guess it's cheap for reason, but when you are unemployed and looking for work,   cheap is what you need. But you also need some reliability and accountability and this service fails on both counts. 

Don't do it.

reviews.title: Feedback Regarding Lost Phone Number Despite Active Subscription
reviews.text:
Hello,

I’m writing to express my frustration with a recent issue I experienced.

I had an active Talkatone Plus subscription and was paying $4.99 per month. One of the advertised benefits of the Plus plan is a non-expiring phone number. However, when I opened the app after some time, I was informed that my number had been reclaimed due to inactivity and that I needed to choose a new one.

This is extremely disappointing because I relied on that number, and maintaining it was one of the main reasons I paid for the subscription. Losing it despite having an active paid plan feels misleading and undermines my trust in the service.

Because of this experience, I have decided to cancel my subscription. It’s difficult to trust a company that does not honor the benefits it promises—especially when those benefits are the reason customers choose to pay.

I hope you take this feedback seriously and improve the reliability and transparency of your service so other customers don’t face the same issue.

Thank you.
